InkOS project: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS

Sprint M7B brand fixes — Vega rejected the Marketing rebuild on these violations.

## P0 — must fix

### Raw `bg-white` (forbidden — Bone token only)
- `app/(app)/marketing/_components/MarketingKPIs.tsx:69, 83, 100` — replace `bg-white` → `bg-[color:var(--color-bone)]` (3 occurrences)

- `app/(app)/marketing/_components/HygieneModal.tsx:229` — same fix

### Off-palette colors in WaitlistList status badges
`app/(app)/marketing/_components/WaitlistList.tsx:57-60` — STATUS_CLASSES dict uses amber/green fully outside the 4-color palette.
- `offered`: `border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800` → `border-[color:var(--color-stone)]/40 bg-[color:var(--color-bone)] text-[color:var(--color-onyx)]`
- `booked`: `border-green-300 bg-green-50 text-green-800` → `border-[color:var(--color-onyx)]/30 bg-[color:var(--color-bone)] text-[color:var(--color-onyx)]`

### Semantic Tailwind tokens (must convert to InkOS CSS vars)
Replace `text-foreground` / `text-muted-foreground` / `border-border` / `bg-card` / `bg-destructive/5` / `text-destructive` with InkOS equivalents:
- `text-foreground` → `text-[color:var(--color-onyx)]`
- `text-muted-foreground` → `text-[color:var(--color-stone)]`
- `border-border` → `border-[color:var(--color-border)]`
- `bg-card` → `bg-[color:var(--color-bone)]`
- `bg-destructive/5` → `bg-[color:var(--color-rust)]/5`
- `text-destructive` → `text-[color:var(--color-rust)]`

Files to fix (every occurrence):
- `components/marketing/ReferralDashboard.tsx` (lines 180, 191–195, 241, 266, 268)
- `components/marketing/TopReferrersList.tsx` (lines 17, 23, 34, 37, 41)
- `components/marketing/ReferralProgramCard.tsx` (lines 146, 149, 157–160, 170–172, 217–218, 264, 288)
- `components/marketing/CodesListFilters.tsx` (lines 112–115)
- `components/marketing/BulkGenerateForToday.tsx` (line 156)
- `components/marketing/TemplateGallery.tsx` (line 57)

Also: `border-foreground bg-foreground text-background` → `border-[color:var(--color-onyx)] bg-[color:var(--color-onyx)] text-[color:var(--color-bone)]`.

### CampaignsHub primary CTA
`components/marketing/CampaignsHub.tsx:105` — `<Button>` lacks Onyx styling. Add:
`className="bg-[color:var(--color-onyx)] text-[color:var(--color-bone)] hover:bg-[color:var(--color-onyx)]/90"`.

## P1 — should fix

### `font-mono` on numeric metrics
`app/(app)/marketing/_components/WaitlistMetricsRow.tsx:39, 51` — JetBrains Mono is forbidden on UI numbers. Remove `font-mono`, keep `tabular-nums`. Inter handles the rest.

### Multiple Rust accents on Audience viewport
`app/(app)/marketing/_components/MarketingKPIs.tsx` — currently 3+ Rust signals on Audience viewport: hero KPI Rust border + hygiene card bg/border/count/link. Per brand rule "max 2 Rust per viewport".
- Keep: hero left border on Open Rate card (Card 1).
- Keep: "Review & remove →" Rust link text on hygiene card.
- REMOVE: `text-[color:var(--color-rust)]` on the bounce count span (around line 116) — make it Onyx.
- REMOVE: tinted `bg-[color:var(--color-rust)]/5` background on hygiene card. Use Bone bg + neutral border.
- KEEP: the Rust outline border on hygiene card ONLY when count > 0.

### `AutoPromoteRulesCard` opacity via template literal
`app/(app)/marketing/_components/AutoPromoteRulesCard.tsx:135-137` — replace template-literal class concatenation with `cn()` from `lib/utils`.

### `SegmentPresetChips` raw white
`components/marketing/SegmentPresetChips.tsx:96` — `bg-white/20` → `bg-[color:var(--color-bone)]/20`.

- `grep -rn "amber\\|green\\|red\\|blue\\|purple\\|teal" components/marketing app/\\(app\\)/marketing` — zero hits (CSS classes; ignore comments/string literals).

- `grep -rn "font-mono" app/\\(app\\)/marketing/_components/WaitlistMetricsRow.tsx` — zero hits.

1. Open `app/(app)/marketing/_components/MarketingKPIs.tsx` and visually confirm the three cards now use `bg-[color:var(--color-bone)]`.
2. Open `WaitlistList.tsx` STATUS_CLASSES and confirm only Onyx/Stone/Bone tokens remain.
